name: Pigeon Cay Beach Club
primary_cta: Check availability (their direct-book engine, with dates and adults filled in)
brand_truth: Eight handmade cottages on a private north Cat Island beach that runs on the honor system: a palapa honor bar, free kayaks and bikes, a card held but no deposit, and you pay on departure.
buyer: US and Canadian couples, families and anglers planning months ahead on a phone, many of them repeat guests, who fear hidden costs and remote logistics.
big_idea: The booking tool is the hero: set your dates and guests and the cottages that fit rise to the front with their own photos, nightly rate and the total with taxes, then hand off to direct-book with the dates filled in.

direction.lane: Sunlit sand, sea glass and deep sea teal
direction.why: Spec asks for one calm serif and a clean sans, barefoot and sunlit; their own photos framed at or below native size.

tier_visual_why: A cottage stay is sold by the place, the cottage and the total. No 3D. Motion: slow crossfading beach band, cards rising on load and re-sorting by fit, totals counting up, a shared stay bar.
concept_type: booking: one-page cottage site, booking strip and cottage chooser as the first screen, hands off to their direct-book engine with dates

critic.by: fresh side-by-side critic subagent (GUIDE.md section 4), after two fix passes

critic_note: First score: wow 3, photography 3, composition 3. Fix 1: true comparison table, route line, cards rise on load, stay bar names the cheapest cottage that fits. Fix 2: taller hero photo with a sheet rising over it, live serif total above the rail. Remaining non-blocking notes: slight seam where the desktop photo shows past the sheet edges, stay bar can cover headings mid-scroll, wedding photo sky.
current_site_findings: No deposit and pay on departure is the last line of the page
Rotating slider of generic lines instead of the honor bar and free kayaks
Eight galleries, 18 wedding photos, 34 gallery photos and 20 FAQs in one scroll
Taxes, meal prices and cancellation terms hidden in pop-ups
Getting here quotes 2016 and 2017 flights and shows a broken FareHarbor widget
pitch_line: Today a guest has to scroll your whole page and open pop-ups to learn what a week costs. Here they set their dates on the first screen and see every cottage that fits, with the real total and $0 due today.
assumptions: Totals apply VAT 10% and resort levy 6% to lodging only; 15% gratuity to meals only.
Dinner estimate counts Wednesday to Saturday evenings inside the stay.
Taxi fare ($60 / $120 round trip) is stated on their site without naming the airport; shown as the airport taxi.
direct-book handoff uses direct-book.com's public URL format (checkInDate, checkOutDate, items[0][adults]); confirm it opens their property correctly.
Flights: Makers Air FLL to Arthur's Town since May 2026 (bahamas.com press release) and Bahamasair Nassau to Arthur's Town twice weekly (Carib Journal, June 2026) are from news, not their site.
Fly Free offer dates (book by June 30, 2027, travel by October 31, 2027) from their site; blackout dates apply.
Cottage one-line descriptions are written from the club's own photos.
The 5 to 6 guest cap on the stepper follows the Big House (sleeps 6).
notes: Gen 2 rebuild to the approved job spec (2026-11-21). Kept from previous: honest total with taxes, all eight cottages with rates and galleries, fees, terms, weddings, getting here, contact; dropped the honor-system tab metaphor per GUIDE section 1. Photos: hotlinked from their site (sandbox cannot reach it). For QA, 17 key photos were fetched as 280 to 560 px WebP thumbnails through the Lovable gallery project ip-assets-pigeon-cay-beach-club (1.2 credits) and routed into Playwright, so screenshots show real photos at low resolution; other gallery photos were judged from that project's written photo report. QA: 0 blockers; interact: 0 dead, 0 JS errors; distinct: distinct (closest 67). Before/after screenshots in /tmp/shots/pigeon-cay-beach-club (session only).
